cards.sentence_en: That's my dad.
cards.note: Slang for pappa; often with the ending: farsan. Mum is morsan.

cards.sentence_en: Shall we go and fill up now?

cards.sentence: Ska vi åka och tanka och sen ska vi handla.
cards.sentence_en: We'll go and fill up and then we'll do the shopping.
cards.note: handla om = to be about: Vad handlar filmen om?

cards.sentence_en: This is the outside of the car.
This is a bonnet.
This is the windscreen.
They can wipe the windscreen.
A windscreen wiper.

cards.sentence: Det här kallar vi bilruta eller ruta.
cards.sentence_en: This we call a car window or a pane.
cards.note: Also a square on paper: rutigt papper = squared paper.

cards.sentence_en: The car has four tyres.
cards.note: Also the deck of a ship.

cards.sentence_en: I can open the boot.

cards.forms: fyller på · fyllde på · har fyllt på
cards.english: to fill up, to top up
cards.sentence_en: We're going to fill up the tank.
Diesel is a type of fuel.
This is a steering wheel.
cards.note: sitta bakom ratten = to be at the wheel.

cards.sentence_en: With the steering wheel I can steer the car.
With it I can honk.
Here's a gear stick.
With the gear stick I can change gear.

cards.forms: lägger i · la i (lade i) · har lagt i
cards.sentence: Vi säger att vi lägger i en växel.
cards.sentence_en: We say that we put the car in a gear.
cards.note: lägga i ettan = put it in first; lägga i backen = put it in reverse.

cards.sentence_en: Reverse is for backing the car up.
cards.note: backen = reverse gear (but en backe is also a hill).

cards.sentence_en: Furthest to the left is the clutch.
cards.note: Verb: koppla = to press the clutch. längst till vänster = furthest to the left.

cards.forms: trycker ner · tryckte ner · har tryckt ner
cards.sentence_en: I can press the pedals down.
Dad is sitting in the driver's seat.

cards.sentence: Jag kör inte så jag är passagerare.
cards.sentence_en: I'm not driving, so I'm a passenger.

cards.sentence: Pappa har tagit på sig ett säkerhetsbälte.
cards.sentence_en: Dad has put on a seatbelt.

cards.forms: tar ur · tog ur · har tagit ur
cards.sentence_en: He released the handbrake.
Now he's going to turn right.

cards.forms: sätter på · satte på · har satt på
cards.english: to switch on, to turn on
cards.sentence: Han sätter på och av vindrutetorkarna med den här spaken.
cards.sentence_en: He turns the wipers on and off with this lever.
Now he's indicating left.
This is the indicator.

cards.forms: svänger av · svängde av · har svängt av
cards.sentence: Vi ska svänga av från den här vägen.
cards.sentence_en: We're going to turn off this road.
And up ahead is a roundabout.

cards.sentence: Nu är vi redan framme vid bensinmacken.
cards.sentence_en: Now we've already reached the petrol station.
How does it feel to fill up the car?
cards.note: känna = to feel (something); kännas = to feel (a certain way). Hur känns det?

cards.sentence: Här ser ni kostnaden i kronor, i svenska kronor.
cards.sentence_en: Here you see the cost in kronor, Swedish kronor.
I bought this soft drink.

cards.sentence: Jag har aldrig sett den smaken förut.
cards.sentence_en: I've never seen that flavour before.
I have to try it.
cards.note: Also to try on clothes: prova en tröja.

cards.sentence_en: He's the driver.

cards.sentence: Nu har vi stannat vid ett trafikljus.
cards.sentence_en: Now we've stopped at a traffic light.
cards.note: Also 'to stay': stanna hemma = stay at home.

cards.sentence_en: He's both riding in and driving the car.
cards.note: köra = to be the driver; åka = to travel, ride (driver or passenger).

cards.sentence_en: So I'm riding in the car too.

cards.forms: i timmen · om dagen · i veckan
cards.sentence_en: They mean 80 km per hour.
cards.note: Swedish uses prepositions for 'per': tre gånger om dagen, en gång i veckan.

cards.sentence: Kilometer i timmen används för att mäta hastighet.
cards.sentence_en: Kilometres per hour is used to measure speed.

cards.sentence: Den siffran vi ser på skylten är vår hastighetsgräns.
cards.sentence_en: The number we see on the sign is our speed limit.
Dad, are you following the speed limit?
He follows the speed limit perfectly.
cards.note: As explained in the video: som ett gott exempel, like a good example.

cards.sentence_en: Here's a long line of cars.

cards.sentence: Nu ska vi åka till en stormarknad och handla mjölk och bröd.
cards.sentence_en: Now we're going to a hypermarket to buy milk and bread.
He parked in a parking bay.
This is a shopping trolley.

cards.sentence: En stormarknad är en stor affär där man kan köpa mat och annat.
cards.sentence_en: A hypermarket is a big shop where you can buy food and other things.

cards.sentence: Med en sån kan man scanna alla varor.
cards.sentence_en: With one of those you can scan all the items.
cards.note: Don't mix up with the verb vara = to be. matvaror = groceries.

cards.sentence_en: Seeded rolls were requested.
There's a special offer here.
It's cheaper than usual.
There are lots of vegetables here.

cards.forms: tappar bort · tappade bort · har tappat bort
cards.sentence_en: Now I lost Dad.
cards.note: tappa = to drop; tappa bort = to lose, mislay.

cards.sentence_en: He buys two cartons of milk.
And I have to buy some toothpaste.
Toothpaste is sold in tubes.

cards.sentence: Det är lätt att tappa bort varandra.
cards.sentence_en: It's easy to lose each other.
There are lots of different flavours.

cards.sentence: Det är olika smaker på chokladen men det är samma märke.
cards.sentence_en: There are different flavours of the chocolate, but it's the same brand.

cards.english: to not have to, to get out of
cards.sentence: Eftersom vi har scannat våra varor så slipper vi den här långa kön eller det är en lång kö för att betala.
cards.sentence_en: Since we've scanned our items, we get to skip this long queue to pay.
cards.note: No direct English word: Jag slipper jobba = I don't have to work (lucky me).

cards.sentence: Han har skannat alla varor på egen hand.
cards.sentence_en: He has scanned all the items himself.

cards.sentence: Men jag köpte några öl och det är ålderskontroll på det.
cards.sentence_en: But I bought some beers and there's an age check on them.
He has to show ID.
cards.note: Casual: leg. Har du leg? = Do you have ID?

cards.sentence: Han behövde bevisa att han är över 18 år.
cards.sentence_en: He needed to prove that he's over 18.

cards.sentence: Nu står en annan bil parkerad framför oss så vi måste backa ut.
cards.sentence_en: Now there's another car parked in front of us, so we have to back out.

cards.sentence: Om du åkte till England, hade du vågat köra bil då?
cards.sentence_en: If you went to England, would you have dared to drive?

cards.forms: kommer in i · kom in i · har kommit in i
cards.sentence: Jag tror att det går ganska lätt att komma in i trafikrytmen.
cards.sentence_en: I think it's quite easy to get into the rhythm of the traffic.
cards.note: det går lätt = it's easy, it goes smoothly.

cards.sentence: Här framför oss är det någon som övningskör.
cards.sentence_en: Here in front of us there's someone practising driving.

cards.sentence: Efter man har övningskört kan man göra ett prov och få sitt körkort.
cards.sentence_en: After you've practised driving, you can take a test and get your driving licence.

cards.forms: kör upp · körde upp · har kört upp
cards.sentence: När man gör ett prov för att få sitt körkort då kallas det att köra upp.
cards.sentence_en: When you take a test to get your driving licence, it's called 'köra upp'.
A driving test we call 'uppkörning'.
He took his driving test 42 years ago.
He's had a driving licence for a long time.
cards.note: länge = long in time; lång = long in size.

cards.sentence_en: It was probably simpler than today.
cards.note: nog = probably. en enkel biljett = a one-way ticket.

cards.sentence_en: Rules you have to follow in traffic.

cards.sentence: Idag när man kör upp så måste man tänka på ekonomisk, miljövänlig körning och det kallar vi eco-driving.
cards.sentence_en: Today when you take the test you have to think about economical, eco-friendly driving, and we call that eco-driving.
It's a loanword from English.

cards.forms: stänger av · stängde av · har stängt av
cards.english: to switch off, to turn off
cards.sentence_en: He switches off the car.

cards.forms: bär in · bar in · har burit in
cards.sentence_en: Now we'll carry in the groceries.
